reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model LXT-CL-1.0, which is a recalled model.
The date code on the label and claim, 1224, is outside the recalled date code range of 0722 to 1223, so the unit is not covered by the recall.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (Nordstrom) within the sale window, and no duplicate claims were found, but these do not overcome the date code mismatch.
